server.name: io.github.KitDevUA/video-vision-mcp
server.description: Analyze any video (local file or URL) into frames + transcript for Claude Code

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a .env file with config (API keys, tuning).
environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_MCP_ENV

environmentVariables.description: Enables tier-3 native Gemini video analysis (default when set).
environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Enables tier-2 OpenAI Whisper transcription.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Enables tier-2 Groq whisper-large-v3 transcription.
environmentVariables.name: GROQ_API_KEY
